BiblicalUsage: Pas-dammim, the boundary of blood, is the place in western Judah where David's mighty men stood their ground in a field of barley against the Philistines. Eleazar stood with David there when the rest of Israel fled.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Pas-dammim teaches me to stand where God has put me: one field, held by faithful men, became a great deliverance.
RelatedEvents: David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
